principle: Project Truth write authority originates with the owner; agents, CI, tools, branches, timestamps and model recommendations are never authority sources by themselves.

OWNER_EXPLICIT.description: The owner directly instructs a bounded change. Necessary truth reconciliation inside that bounded scope is authorized.

OWNER_DERIVED.description: The owner orders blocker/gap/failure resolution using the best or recommended solution. Technical implementation and truth reconciliation necessary to preserve the authorized intent are allowed.

OWNER_DELEGATED_AUTONOMY.description: The owner explicitly delegates continued/autonomous execution within an existing mission, for example continue until green. Necessary implementation and truth reconciliation are allowed without redefining product intent.

NO_AUTHORITY.description: Read-only requests, agent preference, tool output, CI output, research, discovery, or an unrequested recommendation do not authorize Project Truth writes.

high_risk_scope_note: OWNER_DERIVED and OWNER_DELEGATED_AUTONOMY may update canonical files only to record necessary technical consequences while preserving existing product/business/security/owner-control intent. Any material redefinition requires OWNER_EXPLICIT or an explicit owner gate approval.
legacy_history_boundary_reason: This SHA was the certified master before OWNER_AUTHORITY_POLICY enforcement was introduced; prior history is grandfathered, while all later substantive commits require owner-authorized evidence.
